## Overview

First-party list of supported verification tools spanning SAST, DAST, composition, container and vulnerability products, including OWASP Dependency-Check and Dependency-Track, SonarQube, Snyk and GitLab Ultimate.

## Applicability

| Axis | Rating | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Security | core | Verification-tool integration evidence. |
| Cryptography | none | Not cryptographic guidance. |
| This project | core | Informs evidence and verification requirements. |

Bears on DEC-003, R-018, R-021 and R-030.

## Limits
